topic: Human Digestive System Parts and Functions
key_concepts: The digestive system turns food and liquids into building blocks and fuel
The digestive tract is a long twisting tube from mouth to anus
Main digestive organs include mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine,
Accessory digestive organs include tongue, salivary glands, liver, gallbladder, and pancre
Digestion begins in the mouth with chewing and saliva
The esophagus transports swallowed food to the stomach
The stomach mixes food with acids and digestive juices
The liver produces bile that is stored in the gallbladder
The small intestine breaks food into molecules absorbed into the blood
The large intestine absorbs water from undigested food
Waste leaves the body through the anus as feces
Drinking water and eating fiber-rich foods help keep the digestive system healthy
